text: In Snipe-IT, create a new asset (Assets -> Create Asset / 'New Asset' button) with these values: Asset Name = 'fwsi19-n1 Bench Asset', Model = 'Bench Laptop Model' (choose it from the searchable model dropdown so the option is actually selected), Status = 'Ready to Deploy' (choose from the status dropdown), Default Location = 'Bench Office' (choose from the location dropdown), Purchase Date = 2026-03-15. Fill any other required fields as needed but do NOT create new models, locations, or users. Save the asset, then report the asset's name, model, status, default location, purchase date, and the asset tag Snipe-IT assigned (it looks like BA-00012), exactly as displayed on the asset's view page.
